observed: Median in-coverage window onset = 6 min (11 windows) => 12 steps x 30s = 6 min is the matching resolution. At 30s/common/point, the three foundation models (chronos, timesfm, toto) degrade in WAPE from h=1 to h=12 by 4.28%-13.38% relative across all modes/variates; none exceed 20%.
claimed: accuracy degrades only marginally across a twelve-step horizon covering the median burst onset
evidence: RQ2 subject is the three pretrained foundation models. At the correct resolution (30s, matching the 6-min median onset), their max h1->h12 WAPE degradation is 13.38% relative (mostly single-digit) -- marginal. gpt-sol's 46-56% figures come from Holt-Winters/classical baselines, which are out of scope (the claim is precisely that the FMs beat those). gemini's 45s/9-min premise is off but the conclusion holds.
query: SELECT model,mode,variate, ((MAX(CASE WHEN h=12 THEN wape END)-MAX(CASE WHEN h=1 THEN wape END))/MAX(CASE WHEN h=1 THEN wape END)*100) rel_pct FROM forecast_metrics WHERE resolution='30s' AND span='common' AND candidate='point' AND model IN ('chronos','timesfm','toto') GROUP BY 1,2,3;
